1806.90 — chocolate and chocolate-coated products (chocolates, superhero-themed chocolate candy toys)
9503.00 — toys (DIY/building, shooter, maze, vehicle, jewellery, whistle, spinner, stretchy, watch, space, sports, glow, stationery, 'superhit' novelty toys; promotional toys)

2007.99 / 1704.90 — jellies & fruit gummies (classification depends on preparation: fruit-based jellies may fall under 2007.99, sugar-based under 1704.90) — cannot be resolved from public catalogue alone

product_summary: Website candytoy.in (brand 'Hoppin CandyToy') lists two distinct product families: (1) confectionery — lollipops (Watermelon Pop, 5XL Jumbo Lollipop, Disco Man Lollipop), popping candy ('Shock Rock'), chocolates, jellies & gummies, licensed character candies (Paw Patrol, SpongeBob), 'candy toys' where a toy contains candy; (2) toys — a dedicated Promotional Toys section with 14 named categories: DIY, shooter, maze, vehicle, jewellery, whistle, spinner, stretchy, watch, space, sports, glow, stationery and 'superhit' toys. Site claims 300+ products, FSSAI certification, '8 years in business', 'Made in India', B2B/wholesale supply, and retail via Amazon and JioMart. Source: http://candytoy.in/ and http://candytoy.in/promotional-toys/ (retrieved for this check).
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — the site positions itself as a 'Promotional Toys & Custom Novelty Toys Manufacturer' and claims 'Made in India' production, but also describes itself as a bulk/wholesale supplier and sells via Amazon/JioMart; no plant, factory address or production capacity is published on the pages read, so own manufacturing is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Trader/import-resale activity for licensed character goods (Paw Patrol, SpongeBob) is plausible but unverified.
comment: HS mapping: 1704.90 is a correct and well-corroborated code for the sugar-confectionery core (lollipops, popping candy, hard/chewy candy) — exact match. 9503.00 is correct for the toy side and is arguably under-declared rather than wrong: the site shows a full 14-category toy range (DIY, vehicles, spinners, glow, stationery toys, etc.), not just candy-with-toy combos, so 9503.00 should be treated as a primary line, not a secondary one. Missing from the declaration: 1806.90 (chocolates — a clearly advertised product family, 'Chocolates' is a top-level menu item) and a jelly/gummy line (1704.90 or 2007.99 depending on preparation). Possible additional 9505.90 for party/return-gift novelty sets — not corroborated. Industry classification 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is only half right: the company is a dual-line confectionery + toys/novelty-gifts business, and the toy/promotional-gift leg is substantial enough that a pure FMCG label understates it. No HS mismatch is a rejection ground here — company is retained and codes corrected/expanded. IMPORTANT per project rule 5: all product data above comes from the company's own website and catalogue only; no customs line, B/L or GST record was checked in this task, therefore the entire product range and the 'manufacturer' / 'Made in India' / '300+ products' / 'FSSAI-certified' claims are status 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Note also that candytoycorporate.com is a parked Hostinger domain (not the company site) and candytoy.in only resolves over plain HTTP, not HTTPS — a minor credibility signal, not a rejection ground. Revenue, export volumes, CIN/PAN and registry data were deliberately not researched in this task: null.
